name: Mutt Click to Chat
author: Mutt Group / Mutt Studio

sections.description:
Add a floating WhatsApp button to your site. Visitors click it and start a conversation with you in WhatsApp, on the phone or on the computer.

  • Floating button at the bottom right or left, in your color, with an optional tooltip.
  • Chat window with your call to action in chat bubbles, with simple formatting (bold, italic, ~strikethrough~, code) and clickable links.
  • Start message: the text already typed in WhatsApp. Use variables to know where the visitor came from: {SITE}, {TITLE}, {URL}, {HREF}.
  • Open automatically after some seconds, once per visit, and a notification badge on the button.
  • On desktop: open WhatsApp Web or the WhatsApp app, and show a QR code so the visitor can continue on the phone.
  • Opt-in: consent text with an optional required checkbox.
  • Visibility: choose where the button appears (front page, posts, pages, archives, search, shop, product, cart, checkout…). Mobile only option.
  • Per page settings: change the number, call to action and start message, or show/hide the button, on any post, page, product, category or tag.
  • WooCommerce: start message and call to action for product pages, with {PRODUCT}, {SKU}, {PRICE}, {REGULAR} and {DISCOUNT}. Contact button on the product page, also on products without a price.
  • WhatsApp button block and the [mutt_chat] shortcode to put buttons in your content.
  • Analytics (optional, off by default): built-in click counter (no personal data) with a dashboard widget, and events for Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversions.
  • Dark mode (always or following the visitor device).
  • Lightweight: no jQuery on the site, scripts loaded with defer.
  • Translation-ready.

Pro version

Mutt Click to Chat Pro adds several agents with photos, a window to choose the agent or a fixed button that shares the chats between agents, departments, opening hours, a pre-chat form with a lead list, “Order on WhatsApp” for the WooCommerce cart, reports by agent, tracking links and an Elementor widget. Learn more.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Mutt Click to Chat” and install it, or upload the .zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Mutt Chat in the admin menu and type your WhatsApp number.
sections.faq:
How should I type the number?

In international format, with the country and area code. Example for Brazil: 55 11 99999-9999. Spaces, dashes and the + sign are removed when you save.

How do I open the chat window from a link or button of my theme?

Add the CSS class mcwa-open to any element, or link to #mcwa or #whatsapp.

How do I add a button in a post?

Use the “WhatsApp Button” block, or the shortcode: [mutt_chat text="Talk to us" message="Hello!"]. You can also set phone="5511999999999".

Does the plugin save personal data or track visitors?

No. Nothing is sent to the plugin author or to any external service. The click counter and the analytics events are off by default. When you turn the counter on, it only saves how many clicks happened each day, on your own site. When you turn on an analytics option, the event is sent only to the analytics tool you already installed on your site (Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Meta Pixel or Google Ads).

Does it work with cache plugins?

Yes. The button, delays and QR code are handled in the browser.
